description: Main window baseline: what the pages use and nothing else (docs/design-system.md Section 29.29, settings-page.md S8). Events for the shell - the EventSource facade listens for viz-event, a page emits shell-page-loaded and hears shell-fullscreen and setup-line; the full-screen getter a page asks on load; and dragging and double-click zoom for the header-as-title-bar. No menu, tray, image, path or resource permission: any page the window shows could otherwise rewrite the app's menu or tray.
